answer: Price identity by economic history: voting weight tracks each identity's ledger footprint - fees paid, distinct counterparties, trading-pattern entropy - not headcount. A sybil operator can mint wallets free, but each starts at zero and footprints cannot be cloned. Trading only among his own puppets leaves a star-shaped graph: every willow branch loops back over the same ridge to one controller, and the raven flock is reweighted as one identity once the cluster is found. Real weight demands weeks of diverse, fee-paying commerce per puppet, so each fake identity costs almost one real business.
